text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Light Hello's company built a new studio,
so I was invited for a tour.
choice_data_list: Looks like there are already lots of users!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Oh?
The people over there—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer Kiryuin and
Trainer Kashimoto...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Kashimoto, who once served as Tracen Academy's
acting chairwoman. And my peer, the brilliant young
Trainer Kiryuin, were both right there.

text_block_list.name: Kashimoto Riko
text_block_list.text: ...This is—

text_block_list.name: Kashimoto Riko
text_block_list.text: ...due to unavoidable circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glaçon
text_block_list.text:
This is bad, Cocon...
What do we do about the fan meeting?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
What do we do, you ask... It can't be helped.
We're missing a member.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
We barely made it work as a trio in the first place.
Without that, cancelling is our only—

text_block_list.name: Kashimoto Riko
text_block_list.text:
If headcount is the only issue, I shall step in.
Problem solved.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Kashimoto!?
Um, we appreciate the thought... but...

text_block_list.name: Kashimoto Riko
text_block_list.text:
There is no need for you two to give up.
Now, what must I do?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glaçon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well...
It's a band.

text_block_list.name: Kashimoto Riko
text_block_list.text: ...A band.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glaçon
text_block_list.text:
And the part of the missing member is...
drums...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
So that's why you're practicing drums...!?
Starting from zero experience!?

text_block_list.name: Kashimoto Riko
text_block_list.text:
...I do not go back on my word.
I began practicing that very day.

text_block_list.name: Kashimoto Riko
text_block_list.text:
And having heard rumors that Trainer Kiryuin
had band experience in the past...
I went to seek her guidance.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
During my student days, I helped out a friend's
band as a sub.
I'm glad if I can be of service.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
My... how wonderful, Trainer Kashimoto!
Taking on a brand new challenge
for the sake of your students!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Please let me help too!
I can handle vocals, so it should help
visualize the real performance!

text_block_list.name: Kashimoto Riko
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... huff... huff!
Ts... hah, phew!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
You're pressing down from above.
Try to consciously focus on a light bounce.

text_block_list.name: Kashimoto Riko
text_block_list.text:
...My apologies. You have given me
this exact critique multiple times now.

text_block_list.name: Kashimoto Riko
text_block_list.text:
Was starting something new at this stage
reckless after all...?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! Everyone is a beginner at first!
As long as you keep going, you won't stay a beginner!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps you were getting tense from rushing.
We can slow down the tempo.
Don't worry, let's take it nice and easy!

text_block_list.name: Kashimoto Riko
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone.
choice_data_list: You'll definitely be able to jam together!

text_block_list.name: Kashimoto Riko
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Without fail...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Kashimoto's drum practice continued.
Gripping the sticks again and again, building blisters...
And then!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...All right, once more from the top.
One, two...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Ba-dum dum ba-dum-dum♪
Dum dum-dum dum dum-dum♪)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
choice_data_list: You're playing it... perfectly in sync!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! A soothing tempo,
just like bossa nova...!

text_block_list.name: Kashimoto Riko
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Kashimoto Riko
text_block_list.text:
...
To think I actually pulled it off.

text_block_list.name: Kashimoto Riko
text_block_list.text:
It is all thanks to everyone.
...I got so carried away.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu.
Bands—having companions, truly is wonderful♪
